ja.title: TROP2 ADCの曝露を比較する前に：同じ薬のAUCが変わった理由を読む
ja.summary: SGとDato-DXdの一次PK・E–R資料を監査。2026年のSGの派生濃度定義とモデル変更を踏まえ、曝露を借りる前に測定量・時間窓・転帰を照合する。共通payload目標や効力順位は支持できない。
ja.seo_title: TROP2 ADCの曝露を比べる前に：同じ薬のAUCが変わった理由

en.title: Before comparing TROP2 ADC exposure: why a reported AUC changed
en.summary: An audit of sacituzumab govitecan and datopotamab deruxtecan distinguishes measured and derived analytes, label versions, exposure windows and response endpoints. The public summaries do not establish a shared payload target.
en.seo_title: TROP2 ADCs and the limits of payload exposure comparisons
en.seo_description: Public PK results for TROP2 ADCs show why units, analytes, DAR and sampling windows matter before comparing payload exposure.
